_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pelican-eggs/minecraft and pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Minecraft: Quilt
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Quilt, the community mod loader for Minecraft Java that also runs most Fabric mods. Any Minecraft version Quilt supports, with tuned Java settings.
startup: read -r need most 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" -v most="$most" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } if (most != "" && have + 0 > most + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version runs on Java %s at most, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", most, have, most; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Quilt. Runs Quilt's installer (checked against Quilt's
# checksum) for the chosen Minecraft and loader versions, which downloads
# Minecraft and the libraries. Worlds, mods and settings are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# True when version $1 is $2 or older.
older_or_same() { [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$1" "$2" | sort -V | head -n 1)" = "$1" ]; }
# Downloads $1 to $2 and checks it against $3, its published checksum
# (sha256:…, sha1:… or md5:…); a jar with none must at least be a whole
# zip. Only then is it put in place.
fetch() {
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$2.new" "$1" || { rm -f "$2.new"; fail "The download from $1 failed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ -n "${3:-}" ]; then
        if [ "$("${3%%:*}sum" "$2.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "${3#*:}" ]; then
            rm -f "$2.new"
            fail "The download didn't match its published checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        fi
    elif [[ $2 == *.jar ]] && ! unzip -tq "$2.new" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        rm -f "$2.new"
        fail "The download isn't a whole jar file. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mv -f "$2.new" "$2"
}
# True when file $1 has the checksum $2 (as fetch takes it).
matches() { [ -f "$1" ] && [ "$("${2%%:*}sum" "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "${2#*:}" ]; }
# The Java version Minecraft $1 needs, from Mojang's version list (8 for
# versions older than the list says).
java_for() {
    local url
    url=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json | jq -r --arg v "$1" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url') || true
    if [ -n "$url" ]; then get "$url" | jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 8' || echo 8; else echo 8; fi
}
# Writes the Java versions the server runs on to .raptor-java, which the
# startup command checks: the oldest, and for $2 the newest, if any.
write_java() {
    echo "$1${2:+ $2}" > .raptor-java
}
# The newest Java that Forge, and the servers built on Forge or on its
# launcher, run on for Minecraft $1: 8 before 1.13 (LaunchWrapper), 11
# before 1.17 (the old ModLauncher fails on Java 16's locked-down
# internals). Nothing for newer versions.
java_most() {
    [[ $1 == 1.* ]] || return 0
    if older_or_same "$1" 1.12.2; then echo 8
    elif older_or_same "$1" 1.16.5; then echo 11; fi
}
# How to say which Java it runs on.
java_text() {
    if [ -z "${2:-}" ]; then echo "Java $1 or newer"
    elif [ "$1" = "$2" ]; then echo "Java $1 only"
    else echo "Java $1 to $2"; fi
}

meta=https://meta.quiltmc.org/v3
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
unreachable="Quilt can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
games=$(get "$meta/versions/game") || fail "$unreachable"
newest=$(jq -r '[.[] | select(.stable)][0].version' <<<"$games")
mc="${MC_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$mc" = latest ]; then
    mc=$newest
else
    jq -e --arg v "$mc" 'any(.[]; .version == $v)' <<<"$games" >/dev/null ||
        fail "Quilt has no Minecraft $mc. Set Minecraft version to latest, or to a version Quilt has (1.14 or newer), such as $newest."
fi

loaders=$(get "$meta/versions/loader/$mc") || fail "$unreachable"
loader="${LOADER_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$loader" = latest ]; then
    # The newest release, or the newest beta when there's none.
    loader=$(jq -r '.[].loader.version' <<<"$loaders" | grep -v -- - | sort -V | tail -n 1) || true
    [ -n "$loader" ] || loader=$(jq -r '.[].loader.version' <<<"$loaders" | sort -V | tail -n 1)
    [ -n "$loader" ] || fail "Quilt has no loader for Minecraft $mc yet."
else
    jq -e --arg v "$loader" 'any(.[]; .loader.version == $v)' <<<"$loaders" >/dev/null ||
        fail "Quilt has no loader $loader for Minecraft $mc. Set Loader version to latest, or to one Quilt has."
fi

id="quilt $mc $loader"
if [ "$(cat .raptor-loader 2>/dev/null)" = "$id" ] && [ -f "$jar" ] && [ -f minecraft.jar ]; then
    echo "Quilt $loader for Minecraft $mc is already installed."
else
    installer=$(get "$meta/versions/installer" | jq -c '.[0]') || fail "$unreachable"
    stage=.raptor-installer
    rm -rf "$stage"
    mkdir -p "$stage/out"
    echo "Downloading the Quilt installer"
    fetch "$(jq -r .url <<<"$installer")" "$stage/installer.jar" "sha256:$(jq -r .hashes.sha256 <<<"$installer")"
    echo "Installing Quilt $loader for Minecraft $mc"
    if ! HOME=/tmp java -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0 -jar "$stage/installer.jar" install server "$mc" "$loader" --install-dir="$stage/out" --download-server >"$stage/installer-output.log" 2>&1; then
        tail -n 20 "$stage/installer-output.log"
        rm -rf "$stage"
        fail "The Quilt installer failed (its last lines are above). Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    [ -f "$stage/out/quilt-server-launch.jar" ] && [ -f "$stage/out/server.jar" ] ||
        { rm -rf "$stage"; fail "The Quilt installer didn't make a server. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mkdir -p libraries
    cp -a "$stage/out/libraries/." libraries/
    mv -f "$stage/out/server.jar" minecraft.jar
    mv -f "$stage/out/quilt-server-launch.jar" "$jar"
    echo "serverJar=minecraft.jar" > quilt-server-launcher.properties
    rm -rf "$stage"
    echo "$id" > .raptor-loader
fi
need=$(java_for "$mc")
write_java "$need"
echo "Installed Quilt $loader for Minecraft $mc. It runs on $(java_text "$need")."

variables.name: Minecraft version
variables.description: The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.1, or latest for the newest one Quilt supports. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Loader version
variables.description: The Quilt loader version, such as 0.30.2, or latest for the newest release.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.
